text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text: Thank you very much for accompanying me on my shopping trip today.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
As a Trainer, I wanted to hear your opinion
for reference—

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text: ...Over there, it's Little Cocon and Bitter Glasse.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text: What are those two doing at this hour...

text_block_list.name: Little Cocon
text_block_list.text:
...Bitter Glasse.
Don't tell me... you too?

text_block_list.name: Bitter Glasse
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha!
Judging from that look, we must be thinking the exact same thing!

text_block_list.name: Little Cocon
text_block_list.text:
Well... I haven't really decided
what to prepare yet, though.

text_block_list.name: Bitter Glasse
text_block_list.text:
I see! But if we head over there for now,
we're bound to find something!

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text: Preparation? What do you mean by 'over there'...?
choice_data_list: You seemed rather fidgety, didn't you?

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
...Yes. Furthermore, somehow...
they seem almost giddy...

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
choice_data_list: Aren't you going to say something to them?

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text: —Huh?

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
...Ah, indeed.
I certainly should have spoken up.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
........
For now, I'll try following after them.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
It's getting dark,
and we wouldn't want anything bad happening.

text_block_list.name: Bitter Glasse
text_block_list.text:
How about this cake over here?!
It looks really hearty and filling!

text_block_list.name: Little Cocon
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, that's huge!
Trainer Kashimoto couldn't possibly finish all that.

text_block_list.name: Bitter Glasse
text_block_list.text: We'll cross that bridge when we get to it! We'll help out too!

text_block_list.name: Little Cocon
text_block_list.text:
Nah, that kind of defeats the purpose...
Like, it wouldn't really be for Trainer Kashimoto's sake anymore.

text_block_list.name: Little Cocon
text_block_list.text: Anyway, let me think on it first. It has to be something they'll genuinely love.

text_block_list.name: Bitter Glasse
text_block_list.text: Yes! All thanks to Trainer Kashimoto, who always puts us first!

text_block_list.name: Bitter Glasse
text_block_list.text:
If I want to bring a smile to their faces,
I've gotta put my whole heart into it!

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text: Let's hurry home.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
If they come to deliver what they bought,
they'll only find an empty room.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
Let's run!!
Before those girls come back!
Shortly after starting to sprint at top speed, she grew exhausted and dizzy. Lending her a shoulder, I helped her back to the academy.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
*pant*, *pant*... I-I need to catch my breath
and show that I'm composed...

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text: Haaah…… whew.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
...To make them happy...
To bring a smile to their faces, huh?

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text: Even though I told you there was no need to worry about me.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text: Honestly... they're truly hopeless.
A few days later, I asked her about what happened that day.

All she replied with was a single 'It was delicious,'—
but her feelings came through loud and clear.
